tested_question: What do the nested c2=0 and c2-free best fits look like over the complete 1-200 kHz continuum-fit domain?

plot_semantics.continuum_target: line-repaired experimental ASD used by the smooth continuum objective
plot_semantics.raw_experimental_ASD: experimental ASD before narrow-line repair; visual provenance only, not the smooth fit target

guardrail: These plots visualize the same nested fits used by the physical-L+C_tes anchor diagnostic. The fitted target is the line-repaired continuum ASD; the raw experimental ASD is shown only for visual provenance and includes narrow line features excluded from the smooth continuum objective. c2-free improvement is not by itself evidence that c2 is a physical electronics zero.
